sections.label: Reading
sections.title: The Toy Swap
sections.instructions: Read the passage and answer the questions.
sections.passage:
Ella and Ben have a toy box. Ella has a doll and a teddy. Ben has a ball, a car and a train.

“I want the train, please,” says Ella. Ben gives her the train. “Thank you!” she says. Ben points to the teddy. “What is it?” he asks. “It is a teddy. Do you want it?” asks Ella. “Yes, please,” says Ben.

They play for ten minutes. Then they put every toy back in the box. They do not keep each other’s toys.

What does Ben want?
Do they keep each other’s toys?

sections.teacherNotes:
Teacher transcript:
Welcome to our play table. I am Sam. There are five toys here today. I have a red ball and a small blue car. My friend Nina has a doll and a teddy. There is a green train in the middle of the table. The train belongs to our class.

Nina looks at my ball. She says, I want the ball, please. I give her the ball. She says thank you. Then I look at her teddy. What is it? I ask. It is a teddy, she says. Do you want it? Yes, please. I want the teddy. Nina gives it to me. It is soft and brown.

We play together. Nina rolls the ball slowly. I make the teddy wave. Another friend, Alex, comes to the table. He wants the train. He says, Can I have the train, please? We say yes. Alex moves the train around the table.

At the end, we stop playing. Nina gives my ball back. I give her teddy back. Alex puts the train in the class box. We thank each other. Everyone has a turn, and all five toys are safe.

Read the questions aloud for young learners. Replay or reread in short sections if needed.
